_comment: Parameter recovery for the h_m01_size menu-size variant (RQ6; plan 8.5(e), 8.6).
menu_sizes are balanced WITHIN each cell by the design generator, because
gamma_size is identified from the size spread inside a cell.
alpha_var is alpha_cell, not alpha: in h_m01_size alpha varies by observation,
and alpha_cell[j] is alpha at the pool's MEAN menu size (s is centered), which
is what keeps it commensurable with h_m01's alpha[j].
Sampler settings are not the h_m01 defaults. A 500/500 pass at default
adapt_delta gave max R_hat 1.10 with divergences; 1000+ warmup at
adapt_delta 0.9 gave R_hat <= 1.008 and zero divergences across 6 fits.
